## Oct 5 Results: By The Numbers

Let's break down yesterday's performance with precision. We went 1-1 on the day, hitting exactly 50.0% accuracy. The model called two games, and the results split right down the middle. Not spectacular, but the data never lies.

## The Miss Analysis

The Guardians pick at 55% confidence didn't materialize. A marginal edge that didn't convert. The Yankees-Rays call at 50% was essentially a coin flip, and we landed on the right side. That's what happens when you're working with low-confidence spreads.

## Oct 6 Preview: Top Pick Analysis

Tomorrow's slate brings us a high-conviction play. The model is projecting the Atlanta Braves at 63% win probability against the Los Angeles Dodgers. That's a 13-percentage-point edge over a coin flip—statistically significant.

## Pitcher Matchup Metrics

The pitching matchup features Yoshinobu Yamamoto for the Dodgers against Chris Sale for the Braves. Sale's home splits and current form factor heavily into our 63% confidence level. The data supports an Atlanta edge in this one.

## The Bottom Line

Oct 5 gave us a .500 day—nothing to celebrate, nothing to panic about. Oct 6 brings a 63% confidence play on the Braves. When the model shows double-digit edges over 50%, we pay attention. That's where value lives in the long run.
